mapper.select: SELECT apply_id, stu_id, stu_name, change_type, remark, status, submit_time FROM change_apply ORDER BY submit_time DESC
SELECT apply_id, stu_id, stu_name, change_type, remark, status, submit_time FROM change_apply WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY submit_time DESC
SELECT apply_id, stu_id, stu_name, change_type, remark, status, submit_time FROM change_apply WHERE status = '待审核' ORDER BY submit_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO change_apply (stu_id, stu_name, change_type, remark) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{stuName}, #{changeType}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE change_apply SET status = #{status} WHERE apply_id = #{applyId}
